entries.question: Aur Kya kisi ka bhi appointment letter issue hua kya
entries.answer:
मेरे पास वर्तमान में KGMU द्वारा हाल ही में जारी किए गए किसी भी व्यक्तिगत 'नियुक्ति पत्र' (Appointment Letter) या भर्ती परिणामों की सूची उपलब्ध नहीं है। मैं एक AI चैटबॉट हूँ और मेरे पास गोपनीय प्रशासनिक दस्तावेजों या व्यक्तिगत नियुक्ति पत्रों की वास्तविक समय (real-time) जानकारी नहीं होती है।

यदि आपको या आपके किसी परिचित को कोई सूचना प्राप्त हुई है, तो कृपया ध्यान दें:

1. **आधिकारिक वेबसाइट:** KGMU अपनी वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) पर ही चयनित उम्मीदवारों की सूची या जॉइनिंग से संबंधित नोटिस प्रकाशित करता है।
2. **व्यक्तिगत ईमेल/डाक:** नियुक्ति पत्र संबंधित उम्मीदवारों को उनके पंजीकृत ईमेल आईडी या डाक के माध्यम से भेजे जाते हैं। 
3. **सत्यापन:** किसी भी अनधिकृत स्रोत या फोन कॉल पर विश्वास न करें। यदि आपको कोई नियुक्ति पत्र प्राप्त होता है, तो उसकी सत्यता की जांच करने के लिए सीधे विश्वविद्यालय के **रजिस्ट्रार कार्यालय (0522-2253171)** पर संपर्क करना सबसे सुरक्षित है।

यदि आप किसी विशिष्ट भर्ती विज्ञापन (Advertisement) के बारे में जानना चाहते हैं, तो कृपया उसका संदर्भ (Reference Number) दें, ताकि मैं देख सकूँ कि उस विज्ञापन से संबंधित कोई आधिकारिक नोटिस बोर्ड अपडेट है या नहीं।

entries.question: Opd appointment
entries.answer:
To book an OPD appointment at King George's Medical University (KGMU), please note that online registration is mandatory. Here are the available booking methods:

1. **Online (ORS Portal):** Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in), log in or register, select Uttar Pradesh, choose KGMU, select the required department, date, and time, enter patient details, and pay the ₹50 OPD slip fee to download your slip.
2. **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow.
3. **SMS:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT <Patient Name>` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and active mobile number to verify via OTP, obtain a physical token, pay the ₹50 fee, and collect your OPD slip.

**Important Information:**
- **Timings:** Monday–Friday 9:00 AM–1:00 PM; Saturday 9:00 AM–12:00 PM; closed on Sundays.
- **Fees:** ₹50 for all booking methods.
- **Referral:** Patients from outside Lucknow must bring a valid referral letter for the specific department.
- **Cut-off:** The ticket counter closes at 1:00 PM sharp. Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

For further assistance, you can contact the helpline at **0522-2258880** or **0522-3539333**.

entries.question: I want to book an appointment in cardiology department on monday
entries.answer:
To book an appointment in the Cardiology department (LARI Cardiology) at KGMU for a Monday, please follow these guidelines and methods:

### Important Notes
- **Timings:** OPD timings are Monday to Friday from 9:00 AM to 1:00 PM (the ticket counter closes sharp at 1:00 PM). 
- **Referral:** If you are coming from outside Lucknow, please bring a valid referral for the specific department.
- **Fees:** The OPD slip fee is ₹50 across all booking methods. Pre-booking is strongly recommended to avoid long wait times.

### Booking Methods
1. **Online Registration System (ORS):** 
   - Visit [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in)
   - Select Uttar Pradesh → King George's Medical University (KGMU)
   - Choose New Appointment, select the Cardiology department and desired Monday date
   - Fill in patient details, pay the ₹50 fee online, and download your appointment slip.
2. **ABHA / Health Care App:** Register using your mobile number and OTP, then follow the same state and hospital selection flow as above.
3. **SMS Booking:** Send an SMS in the format `APPOINTMENT [Patient Name]` to **8887019134**.
4. **Walk-in:** Visit the hospital with your Aadhaar number and an active mobile number to complete OTP verification, receive a physical token, pay ₹50, and collect your OPD slip.

entries.question: Kahan Jana hai pura complete process btao
entries.answer:
Here is the complete step-by-step process to get your teeth alignment (braces/orthodontic treatment) done at KGMU:

### Step 1: Registration & Appointment (Mandatory)
Online registration is mandatory before visiting the hospital.
1. **Book Online:** Go to the [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) portal or use the ABHA/Health Care App.
2. **Select Location & Hospital:** Choose **Uttar Pradesh** as your state and select **King George's Medical University (KGMU)**.
3. **Choose Department:** Select the **Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics** department for teeth alignment.
4. **Pay & Download:** Pay the **₹50** OPD slip fee online and download your appointment slip. *(Alternatively, you can book via SMS by sending `Appointment [Patient Name]` to 8887019134).*

### Step 2: Reaching KGMU Campus
- **Where to go:** Head towards the dental wing of KGMU. 
- **Gate Entry:** Use **Gate 2 (Main Hospital/OPD & Dental Gate)** as it is the best entrance for accessing the Dental OPD and registration areas. (Coordinates: [26.8670, 80.9159]). 
- **Timing:** Reach early. OPD timings are Monday to Friday (9:00 AM – 1:00 PM) and Saturday (9:00 AM – 12:00 PM). Note that ticket/registration counters close sharply at 1:00 PM.

### Step 3: Physical Verification & Token
- If you booked online, show your appointment slip/SMS at the counter or kiosk to get your physical token/OPD card if required. Make sure to carry a valid **Aadhaar card** and your active mobile number.

### Step 4: Doctor Consultation
- Head to the **Department of Orthodontics & Dentofacial Orthopaedics** (Dental Faculty building).
- Show your OPD slip to the staff outside the examination rooms. 
- The orthodontist will examine your teeth, assess your alignment, and explain the required treatment plan (such as braces or clear aligners), along with any necessary X-rays or investigations.

entries.question: Consultantatin ke baad surgery ke liye aage ka kya process hai
entries.answer:
Consultation ke baad surgery ke liye aage ka process aam taur par is tarah hota hai:

1. **Doctor ki Salah aur Advise:** Jab aap Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery department ke doctor ko dikhayenge, toh doctor aapki condition ki jaanch karke tay karenge ki surgery zaroori hai ya nahi aur kaun si procedure ki jayegi.
2. **Investigation / Jaanchein:** Doctor aage ki aawashyakta anusar kuch khoon ki jaanchein (blood tests), X-ray, ya doosri imaging/investigations likh kar denge. Ye jaanchein KGMU ke andar hi karwayi ja sakti hain.
3. **Fitness Clearance:** Agar koi anya beemari ya samasya hai, toh anesthetic ya doosre departments se fitness clearance liya jata hai.
4. **Surgery ki Date (Booking):** Sabhi reports aur fitness clear hone ke baad, doctor ya department ki taraf se aapko surgery ke liye agali tarikh (date) di jayegi aur zaroori instructions bataye jayenge.
5. **Admission aur Shulk (Fees):** Tay shuda tarikh par hospital mein admission kiya jata hai. KGMU ki rate list ke anusaar Plastic Surgery ke alag-alag procedures ke charges ₹50 se lekar ₹20,000 tak ho sakte hain (ye procedure ke prakar par nirbhar karta hai).

Kripya vishesh salah ke liye direct Department of Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery ke OPD counter par sampark karein.

entries.question: Teeth ka cleaning bhi krwana padega?
entries.answer:
Yes, scaling (teeth cleaning) is usually required before starting any teeth alignment (orthodontic) treatment. 

Orthodontic appliances like braces make it harder to maintain oral hygiene, and moving teeth that have gum disease or plaque buildup can harm your dental health. Therefore, the orthodontist will typically check your gums and teeth during your consultation and advise you to get a professional cleaning done—often within the **Periodontology** department—to ensure your teeth and gums are completely healthy before starting the alignment process.

entries.question: मुझे मैक्सोफेशल दिखाना h
entries.answer:
मैक्सिलोफेशल सर्जरी (Oral & Maxillofacial Surgery) दिखाने के लिए आपको किंग जार्ज मेडिकल यूनिवर्सिटी (KGMU) के डेंटल विभाग में जाना होगा।

**OPD पंजीकरण और समय:**
- ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप [ORS Portal](https://ors.gov.in) के माध्यम से अपॉइंटमेंट ले सकते हैं।
- OPD का समय: सोमवार से शुक्रवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक और शनिवार सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक (रविवार बंद)।
- OPD पर्ची शुल्क: ₹50

**कैंपस नेविगेशन:**
- मैक्सिलोफेशल सर्जरी विभाग शाह मिना रोड बेल्ट के अंतर्गत स्थित है (पुराने डेंटल कॉलेज के पास)। 
- मुख्य अस्पताल/OPD के लिए **गेट नंबर 2** (सबसे व्यस्त गेट) का उपयोग करें।

यदि आपको कोई स्वास्थ्य संबंधी व्यक्तिगत सलाह चाहिए, तो कृपया KGMU OPD के डॉक्टर से परामर्श लें।

entries.question: Meri wife ko peeth mein Dard rahta hai aur unhe aage jhukne mein pareshaani Hoti hai isiliye doctor ko dikhana hai
entries.answer:
I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

Aap apni wife ko dikhane ke liye **Orthopedic Surgery Department** ya **Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation (PMR)** department mein OPD appointment le sakte hain. 

**OPD Booking ke liye:**
- Online registration mandatory hai, jiske liye aap [ORS Portal](https://ors.gov.in) par ja sakte hain.
- OPD slip ki fee ₹50 hai.
- Samay: Somvaar se Shukravaar (9:00 AM se 1:00 PM) aur Shanivaar (9:00 AM se 12:00 PM).

Department ki adhik jankari ke liye aap [Orthopedic Surgery Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=22&dept_type=2) ya [Physical Medicine & Rehabilitation](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=4&dept_type=2) ka link dekh sakte hain.

entries.question: Vade paythologe 21no may jac riport
entries.answer:
To go from the New OPD to Badi Pathology, follow this route:
1. Start from Linker Road and move toward the Gate 1 Road.
2. Pass the Kalam Centre.
3. Take a right turn at the Forensic T-Point.
4. Continue to Badi Pathology (the entrance faces the Biochemistry road).

If you need a test report or assistance, you can also check the [Pathology Department details](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=5&dept_type=2) or visit the KGMU Main Website at [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org). 

*Disclaimer: I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.*

entries.question: Cchn fees and admission date
entries.answer: For information regarding admission dates, fee structures, and eligibility for courses at King George's Medical University (KGMU), please visit the official KGMU Admissions page: [https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php](https://www.kgmu.org/courses_admission.php).

entries.question: Cardiac surgeon ki OPD kgmu mein kab kab hoti hai
entries.answer:
KGMU mein Thoracic Surgery aur Cardiac surgery se jude vibhag ki OPD ki jankari is prakar hai:

- **Thoracic Surgery:** Room No. 312 mein Thursday ke din OPD hoti hai.
- **Cardiovascular & Thoracic Surgery (CTVS) / Cardiac Surgery:** Iske liye aap official website ya Department of Cardiovascular & Thoracic Surgery page dekh sakte hain: [Cardiovascular & Thoracic Surgery](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=34&dept_type=2).

OPD me aane se pehle online registration (ORS) ya [kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) par latest schedule jarur check kar lein.

entries.question: Non teaching ki jo post aayi thi unme Joining process start hua abhi ya nhi
entries.answer:
KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट पर गैर-शिक्षण (non-teaching) पदों की भर्ती प्रक्रिया या जॉइनिंग के संबंध में अभी तक कोई विशेष सार्वजनिक सूचना जारी नहीं की गई है।

कृपया समय-समय पर KGMU की आधिकारिक वेबसाइट [www.kgmu.org](https://www.kgmu.org) के **'Notice Board'** सेक्शन को चेक करते रहें, जहाँ भर्ती से संबंधित सभी नवीनतम अपडेट्स और परिणाम घोषित किए जाते हैं:
[https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php](https://kgmu.org/kgmu_notice_board.php)

यदि आप किसी विशिष्ट भर्ती विज्ञापन का संदर्भ दे रहे हैं, तो कृपया उसका नोटिफिकेशन नंबर बताएं ताकि मैं उपलब्ध डेटा के आधार पर आपकी बेहतर सहायता कर सकूँ।

entries.question: Pet pet ke doctor hai
entries.answer:
हाँ, KGMU में पेट और पाचन तंत्र से जुड़ी बीमारियों के इलाज के लिए विशेषज्ञ डॉक्टर और विभाग उपलब्ध हैं। 

आप पेट, लिवर और आंतों से जुड़ी समस्याओं के लिए निम्नलिखित विभागों में दिखा सकते हैं:

1. **Medical Gastroenterology (मेडिकल गैस्ट्रोएंटरोलॉजी):** [विभाग की जानकारी देखें](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=49&dept_type=2)
2. **Surgical Gastroenterology (सर्जिकल गैस्ट्रोएंटरोलॉजी):** [विभाग की जानकारी देखें](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=32&dept_type=2)
3. **General Surgery (जनरल सर्जरी):** [विभाग की जानकारी देखें](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=31&dept_type=2)

**ओपीडी (OPD) से जुड़ी जानकारी:**
* ऑनलाइन पंजीकरण अनिवार्य है। आप [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) के माध्यम से अपॉइंटमेंट बुक कर सकते हैं।
* OPD का समय: सोमवार से शुक्रवार (सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 1:00 बजे तक) और शनिवार (सुबह 9:00 बजे से दोपहर 12:00 बजे तक), रविवार को बंद रहता है।
* OPD पर्ची का शुल्क ₹50 है।

*नोट: यदि आप किसी गंभीर चिकित्सीय स्थिति में हैं, तो कृपया KGMU के आपातकालीन विभाग (Trauma Centre) में संपर्क करें। अपनी कोई भी निजी या चिकित्सीय जानकारी चैट में साझा न करें।*

entries.question: Typhoid bukhar hai opd me kaha doctor dekhte
entries.answer:
I'm not qualified to provide medical advice. Please consult a doctor at KGMU OPD or call the helpline. Also, please avoid sharing personal details in this chat for your safety.

For general fever or suspected typhoid, you should report to the **Medicine OPD**. 

**Important Information for your visit:**
*   **Online Registration:** Mandatory for OPD. You can book an appointment at [ors.gov.in](https://ors.gov.in) or via the Health Care App.
*   **Fees:** ₹50 for the OPD slip.
*   **Timings:** Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM – 1:00 PM; Saturday, 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM.
*   **Help Line:** 0522-2258880 or 0522-3539333.
*   **Location:** Please enter through Gate 2 (Main Hospital/OPD) for registration and consultation. 

If you are coming from outside the city, please carry a valid referral for the Medicine department. If your condition is severe or involves persistent high fever, you may visit the Trauma Centre (Gate 14) for emergency assessment.

entries.question: Cardiology appointment kaise kare
entries.answer:
Cardiology department (Lari Cardiology) me appointment ya OPD booking ke liye aap in tariko ka upayog kar sakte hain:

1. **Online Booking (ORS Portal):** 
   - [Online Registration System (ORS)](https://ors.gov.in) par visit karein.
   - Apna state (Uttar Pradesh) aur hospital (KGMU) select karein.
   - Cardiology department aur available date/time select karke patient details bharein.
   - ₹50 ka OPD slip fee online pay karke slip download kar lein.

2. **Mobile App:** 
   - ABHA/Health Care App ke madhyam se mobile number aur OTP se register karke bhi booking ki ja sakti hai.

3. **SMS dwara:** 
   - `Appointment [Patient Name]` likhkar **8887019134** par SMS bhejein.

4. **Walk-in (Offline Booking):** 
   - Aap KGMU aakar counter se bhi booking kar sakte hain. Apne sath Aadhaar card aur active mobile number zaroor rakhein (OTP ke liye). 
   - OPD slip ka fee ₹50 hai. 
   - *Dhyan dein:* Parchi counter dopahar 1:00 PM baje band ho jata hai, isliye samay par pahunchein. Bahar ke shahron ke patients ke liye sambandhit department ka valid referral hona anivarya hai.

Kisi bhi sahayata ke liye aap Lari Cardiology ke PRO Office se **9415099528** par sampark kar sakte hain.

entries.question: KGMU me plastic surgery hota hai kya face ka
entries.answer:
Haan, KGMU (King George's Medical University) mein face (chehre) ki plastic surgery hoti hai. 

KGMU ka **Department of Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery** chehre ki surgeries (jaise cleft lip, facial trauma, burn scars, aur cosmetic/reconstructive surgeries) ki suvidha pradan karta hai. 

Aap is department ke baare mein adhik jankari ke liye official page dekh sakte hain: [Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery Department](https://www.kgmu.org/department_details.php?dept_id=25&dept_type=2).
